sinopsis.es: En el bar Babel, donde vivos y muertos se mezclan, Dante busca recordar su pasado antes de que la Flaca, la Muerte en esta ciudad, cobre su deuda. Jacob oculta a su padre, cura fanático, su deseo de ser drag queen, y Uma, una gitana, intenta engañar a la Flaca para salvar a su hija. Sus destinos chocan en una lucha contra lo inevitable.
sinopsis.en: At the Babel bar, where the living and the dead mingle, Dante tries to recall his past before la Flaca, Death in this city, collects her debt. Jacob hides from his fanatical priest father his wish to be a drag queen, and Uma, a Gypsy woman, tries to trick la Flaca to save her daughter. Their destinies collide in a fight against the inevitable.
